policy: States: pending, in_review (a named reviewer has started), approved (reviewer, credentials and a real review date recorded), rejected (reviewed and not approved; content is being corrected), and expired (an approval older than review_every_days: 180 for urgent rules, 365 otherwise). Only an approved, unexpired area is shown to users as clinician-reviewed. Review dates can never be in the future. Organization and scope record what the reviewer states they reviewed. Credentials are recorded as the reviewer states them; SymptoSense does not verify licences with any authority. Editing content never counts as a clinical review, and every state change is kept in the area's history.
